in_arabic.name: مَحْفُظ
in_arabic.long_meaning: مَحْفُظ يُعَدُّ اسْمًا إسلاميًا يَقول بِالحفظ والاعتناء، وَهو مُشتق من الحفظ في اللغة العربية، وَهذا الاسم يُستخدم في القرآن الكريم لِلمُستوفزين الحفظ وَالراجين الحفظ، وَهو اسْمٌ مُميز في الإسلام يَذكُر الحفظ على المُستوفزين وَالراجين، وَهو اسْمٌ يُشير إلى الحفظ والاعتناء في الإسلام، وَهو اسْمٌ يُميز في الإسلام الحفظ والاعتناء على المُستوفزين وَالراجين

in_english.name: Mahfuz
in_english.meaning: Forgiveness and pardon, one who is protected and preserved
in_english.long_meaning: Mahfuz is an Islamic name that means 'one who is protected and preserved' and has a rich etymology in Arabic. It is mentioned in the Quran as a name for those who are preserved and protected by Allah. The Arabic root of the name, 'h-f-z', conveys the idea of protection and preservation. In Islamic tradition, Mahfuz is associated with the concept of protection and preservation, highlighting the importance of safeguarding one's faith and integrity. The name is also linked to the idea of forgiveness and pardon, as it implies a state of being preserved and protected from sin and wrongdoing. Overall, Mahfuz is a name that reflects the values of protection, preservation, and forgiveness in Islam.
